scope: Host-bound business intent, persistent effect journal, native tool admission, result reconciliation and separately authorized compensation; not universal exactly-once execution

documentation.output: Temporary local directory only; no publish
documentation.network: Existing Mermaid CDN URL checked with network access
documentation.notes: Existing INFO messages about three older anchor links remain; no new guide link warnings

verification.skipReason: Optional real-provider test is not enabled

finalStateFollowUp.reason: Move native checked-completion callbacks inside core governance before successful step registration, and recheck session after observer completion

identity.intent: Authenticated host business workflow supplies stable intentId, expectedState and optional forward receipt; model tool call id is never the business idempotency key
identity.key: tenantId + principalId + namespace + intentId, with separate FORWARD/COMPENSATION phases
identity.requestDigest: Actual registered tool, effective parameters, schema, expected state and parent proof are pinned for the intent
identity.backendToken: Stable intent/phase digest independent of agent, task, session, model call id and journal deployment identity
identity.catalog: Policy binds the reviewed persistent ledger identity; normal starts must compare configured identity, not silently bootstrap a replacement
identity.delegation: Effect rules enter the signed policy fingerprint; removing or changing namespace, schema, phase or catalog is refused; old tool policies without effects retain legacy fingerprint

stateMachine.preparedExpiry: No dispatch was admitted: NOT_APPLIED permits same-payload retry with increased attempt and new private lease
stateMachine.runningExpiry: Dispatch may have applied: UNKNOWN is durable and never becomes a retry because of TTL, restart or clock rollback
stateMachine.committed: Read-only backend recovery verifies receipt and stored original-result digest; permissions, approval and post checks still run
stateMachine.notApplied: Retry needs trusted non-application evidence; a missing backend record alone is insufficient
stateMachine.lateReceipt: An original private capability can complete its own UNKNOWN attempt; late confirmation does not revive a revoked root or deliver its result
stateMachine.postFailure: A post-policy denial or response delivery failure cannot erase a business COMMITTED record
stateMachine.limits: Lease <= min(300000ms, session remainder), checkpoint <= 1MiB, review records <= 128, JDBC statement timeout 1..30 seconds

backendContract.atomicityRequired: Business backend must atomically validate expected state, entity access, idempotency token/request digest and attempt fence with business commit and stored receipt
backendContract.noDistributedTransaction: SDK journal commit and business commit are separate; ordinary callback errors or HTTP timeouts imply UNKNOWN, not rollback
backendContract.absenceReconciliation: Before asserting NOT_APPLIED, a trusted backend must fence/tombstone delayed older attempts; provider-specific fencing is not certified by these tests
backendContract.result: Bounded immutable JSON at core boundary; native tool adapter currently requires String result
backendContract.interruptHandling: Known receipt persistence temporarily clears an existing cancellation interrupt and restores it afterward; failed storage still requires reconciliation

authorizationAndApproval.requiredMarker: A policy-required effect cannot be executed through ordinary core/native tool wrappers; low-level coordinator also requires the real admitted SDK action
authorizationAndApproval.mode: Required effects refuse execution in EVALUATE_ONLY rather than silently bypassing reliability
authorizationAndApproval.approvalTarget: PolicyRequest.effect carries host intent, state, phase, schema, catalog and compensation parent; target digest enters approval action identity and survives parameter rewrite
authorizationAndApproval.management: Same tenant/principal and explicit governance:effects:inspect or governance:effects:reconcile; TrustedContext itself is not token authentication
authorizationAndApproval.compensation: Separate tool, permission, normal approval and exact committed forward proof; its own phase is idempotent and may become UNKNOWN; no automatic remote rollback
authorizationAndApproval.completionCallbacks: Checked native completion observers execute inside the core boundary before successful step registration; observer failure or session revocation cannot deliver success, while business COMMITTED proof remains recoverable

jdbc.coordination: Per-intent row lock, metadata-only bounded transaction retries, stable catalog id and strict bounded checkpoint decoding
jdbc.stored: Status, attempt, expiry, opaque owner ids, request/result digests, private lease hash and opaque receipt/review ids; no raw tool payload or complete result
jdbc.integrity: Checksum detects accidental corruption, not a database administrator rewriting state
jdbc.productionLimits: No production database dialect, pooling timeout, HA, backup/restore or malicious administrator certification

realProcessExperiments.transport: Independent SDK JVMs, authenticated loopback HTTP business service and H2 TCP

realProcessExperiments.fault: Backend transaction commits; HTTP response is held; owned worker JVM is forcibly terminated
realProcessExperiments.clock: Explicit test clock advances past lease expiry, then rolls back
realProcessExperiments.beforeReview: New independent JVM returns effect_outcome_unknown without another execute request
realProcessExperiments.review: Trusted host reads actual durable backend receipt and records matching attempt reconciliation
realProcessExperiments.afterReview: New JVM only recovers original result

realProcessExperiments.afterRelease: Original completes and later independent JVM recovers

focusedTestClasses.EffectJournalTest: Private lease ownership, preparation expiry, unknown restart, fingerprint pinning, proof conflicts, explicit compensation, review identity and corrupt restore
focusedTestClasses.EffectTargetTest: Approval business identity retained across parameter rewrite, target changes alter digest
focusedTestClasses.JdbcEffectLedgerTest: Concurrent multi-instance claim, persistent unknown/clock rollback, access isolation, corrupt checkpoint, approval on replay, wrapper bypass, CAS race, response loss, post denial, compensation, recovery digest, cancellation races, lost commit acknowledgment and observation mode
focusedTestClasses.EffectDelegationTest: Five signed binding replacement refusals and legacy non-effect tool fingerprint compatibility
focusedTestClasses.EffectToolTest: Eight native cases: sync/async wrappers, plain wrapper refusal, actual AiService loop, and sync/async checked-callback exception/revocation with safe later recovery
focusedTestClasses.EffectProcessTest: Three independent JVM/HTTP/durable business receipt experiments

notVerified: Production business provider authentication, payment/message vendor idempotency, receipt authenticity or fence semantics
Production IAM, approver identity integration, separation of duties and durable human approval
Exactly-once execution for arbitrary Java callbacks, unwrapped tools or external APIs
Persistent node outbox, cross-database atomic commit, reliable audit transport, retention/encryption or tamper-proof storage
Production database dialect, high availability, failover, disaster recovery and safe effect-record cleanup
Browser UX for effect management or live-provider execution; no frontend changes in this phase
